info.name: Swish Analytics Sportsbook ATP Tennis Soccer API

description.content:
Machine-learning sportsbook data API from Swish Analytics: player prop pricing, pre-match and in-play match/team markets, bet-request (single and parlay) pricing, and results across NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, NCAA basketball & football, ATP, WTA and soccer. Derived by the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline from the provider's live documentation service (docs-api.swishanalytics.com/v1). Content is faithful to published docs; not an authoritative provider-published OpenAPI.
